entries.description: The UK administered Christmas Island from Singapore
entries.subject: The UK

spans.text:
The UK administered Christmas Island from Singapore.

Japan invaded the island in 1942, but islanders sabotaged Japanese mining operations, making the mines relatively unproductive.
